params.body:
Follow-up on #868. The "Weergaven per kanaal, alle garages" block on Inzichten > Activiteit drew five separate strips on one time axis. With car views counted only since 27 September (widget) and 30 September (own website, colleagues after the owner split), every strip in the default 30-day window was a groove with a few bars in its right edge. The buy-overs strip's axis also read "1, 1, 0", because half of a maximum of 1 rounds back up to 1.

## What changes

- **One stacked bar per step** (per day, per month above 120 days, as before) for the three car-view channels, which count the same thing: own website (`site`), widget (`embed`), colleagues on the platform (`platform`). They stack bottom-up in that order, in `--brand-navy`, `--brand-blue` and `--brand-amber`.
- **Legend** with each channel's colour, its total over the axis and the day it started counting ("nog niet geteld" for a channel never counted).
- **Readout per bar** on hover and on keyboard focus (`tabindex="0"`): the day, the number per channel counted that day, and the sum. A channel not yet counted on that day is left out of the stack and out of the readout. It does not show up as a zero.
- **Widget geopend** and **Overnames afgerond** are other units, so they stay out of the stack. They are two low strips under it, on the same axis, each on its own scale.
- **Integer ticks** (`Measures::ticks`): below a maximum of 3 the axis carries only the maximum and 0. From 3 up, the top becomes the next even number, so the middle label is a whole number that sits exactly on the half line. That removes both "1, 1, 0" and the half line labelled 2 for 1.5 at a maximum of 3.

## The time axis: it starts where the measuring does

I chose to **start the axis on the first step any car-view channel was counted**, and the header says "gemeten sinds 27/09". I did not keep the window with a shaded "nog niet gemeten" part. In the 30-day window, 26 of 30 columns would still have been empty, only labelled. That is the problem we were fixing. With the axis starting on 27/09, the four measured days take the full width.

The cost is the buy-overs strip, which reaches back to 2020. It now counts only over the shown axis. Its total beside the strip is the sum of its bars, and its "sinds" date still says when buy-overs start. The strip is there as a reference for the colleague views, which do not exist before that first day anyway. A window that starts after the first car view, or a channel set with nothing counted at all, keeps the whole window and shows no "gemeten sinds".

`Measures::channels()` is unchanged. `Measures::stacked()` builds on it, and the stacking itself is `Measures::stack()`, separate from the queries. The cache key moves to `activity.screen.5` because the shape of the cached array changed.

## Styling

- The bars reuse the groove, guide lines and readout of the existing series (`.act-groef`).
- The layers are `<i>` elements, so the groove's `span` rule does not paint them all blue. Their colours are Tailwind arbitrary classes on the brand tokens in the blade.
- The few structural rules (column direction, the multi-line readout, focus, the low strips) are in `resources/css/insights.css`, next to the other `.act-*` rules.
- `flex-wrap` is one of the utilities the theme pins with `!important` (`TheThemeOverrulesEverySpacingClassTest`), so wrapping is a `.act-*` rule.
- `refresh.css` is untouched. No new globals and no chart library.

## Rule

R P3-16.23 now describes the stacked view:
- the stack and its legend
- the readout per bar
- where the axis starts and what the header says then
- the two reference strips
- integer ticks

The old text said "geen stapel" because a stack makes every layer above the first unreadable. The readout per bar answers that: every layer can be read off as a number.

## Tests

- `WhereAViewAndALeadCameFromTest` (all `@rule P3-16.23`):
  - the stack sums the three channels per step
  - a channel adds nothing (null, not 0) before its own first day
  - the axis starts on the first counted car-view day, and the reference strips follow it
  - a window inside the measured time is not cut
  - with nothing counted the window stays
  - ticks are whole numbers and never repeat for every maximum from 0 to 500
  - the tab shows the stack, the legend and both strips
  - every stacked bar carries a focusable readout with its split and total, and does not name a channel on a day before it counted
- The existing `ABarYouCanReadANumberOffTest` still passes: every bar with a height carries a readout.
- Full suite, PHPStan and Pint on the changed PHP files: clean locally.
params.title: Inzichten activity: views per channel as one stacked chart
